android.desc: BrainBustle is a democratic social platform where ideas matter more than egos. Cast anonymous votes on real-world topics, see how different demographics think, and engage in thoughtful discourse — all without algorithmic manipulation

show_hn.title: Show HN: Could you please check out my social media website/mobile app?

quotes.text:
Greetings, 
I would like to know why or why you wouldn't use Brainbustle.com It is for those who hate social media as much as those who like it. We are all aware of the industries shortcoming and missed opportunities and this is an attempt to rectify that for those interested. We have gone about it attempting to do every single aspect with the best of intentions.  I am interested to see what people value most/least since there are lot of subtle features with various uses. Of course I want to know of any bugs. It's quite hard to find them on my own.

It is available on mobile as well https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.brainbustle.app

This goes directly to the info page https://brainbustle.com/how-it-works

I need folks to specifically vote on posts and create a few of their own. I would like you to subscribe if possible, three lower tiers are FREE, no skin off your bum. 
I would like you to check out both the PC and mobile app if possible, only big difference there is you have more choices crafting notes. If you know communities that would love the app that would be peachy. Thanks again.
